definition.tail: exactly one slash in each three-cell tail
definition.selection: slash position selects one consecutive three-cell body row
definition.selected_row: exactly one mark differs from the other two

provenance_caution: The one-exception criterion was introduced after row/column outputs had been inspected. Experiment 339 finds the qualitative row-survives/column-dies asymmetry in roughly one quarter of matched null permutations, so the discovery basis is weak/post-hoc. The family remains frozen only for post-freeze holdout and prospective falsification; it must not be tuned further.

retrospective_null_calibration.exact_count_caution: The exact 12/0 outcome was not preregistered and is not a confirmatory p-value.
retrospective_null_calibration.evidentiary_status: weak retrospective discovery; post-freeze holdout and prospective predictions remain frozen

holdout_correction.reason: The family was selected using the complete observed corpus. For any hidden cell, the original full-data witness remains possible; if the hidden-cell prediction is a singleton, it must equal the original symbol.
holdout_correction.clean_future_evidence: new physical observations at residues 84 or 102, or an independently recovered cue specifying the same operation
